names.legendary: Captain Schipp of the Black Barge

lore.common: Barks at every boat that dares to sail past its window, even toy boats in the bath.
lore.uncommon: Rides at the front of the canal barge and barks orders the boatman pretends to follow.
lore.rare: Patrols the deck so thoroughly that not a single crumb has ever reached the river.
lore.epic: Barked so commandingly at a traffic jam of barges that they lined up in perfect order for the locks.
lore.legendary: Steered a barge the length of every canal in the land with its paws on the tiller. The ducks gave it right of way.

lore.common: Refuses to walk in the rain, the wind or any direction you suggest.
lore.uncommon: Trots along with its nose in the air as if it owns the pavement, the street and the town.
lore.rare: Once decided not to move for an entire afternoon. The lead, the owner and the postman all gave up.
lore.epic: Sat down in the middle of the castle drawbridge and the whole parade had to go round the long way.
lore.legendary: Was offered the keys to the castle and turned them down because the castle was not tidy enough.

lore.common: Lies across the entire sofa with its long legs, then sighs when you ask for a corner.
lore.uncommon: Walks so softly on its long legs that the sheep don't notice it until it says hello.
lore.rare: Can outrun the wind on a highland hill, then stops to sniff a single flower.
lore.epic: Ran across the glen so fast that the mist was left behind and had to catch up.
lore.legendary: Was asked to carry a message from one end of the Highlands to the other. Arrived before the sender had finished writing it.

lore.common: Its eyebrows are so bushy that it has to lift them to see what it is barking at.
lore.uncommon: Pulls silly faces until everyone at the table laughs and drops a sausage.
lore.rare: Can squeeze into any badger hole, then refuses to come out until it has been offered a snack.
lore.epic: Told such good jokes at the village fair, mostly with its eyebrows, that the clown resigned.
lore.legendary: Was appointed official jester of a Welsh castle. Has never repeated a joke, mainly because it can't remember them.

names.legendary: Sheltie Belle of the Northern Isles

lore.common: Barks at every leaf that falls in autumn and treats each one as an emergency.
lore.uncommon: Herds the ducks on the pond into a neat queue, then looks back for applause.
lore.rare: Senses when anyone in the house is sad and arrives with a toy before they've even sat down.
lore.epic: Rounded up every pony on the island and parked them by size, from smallest to slightly less small.
lore.legendary: Kept every sheep on a windy island together through a winter storm. Barked a cheerful hello to each of them every morning.

names.legendary: Princess Shih of the Golden Pillow

lore.common: Its topknot droops over its eyes until someone ties it up with a ribbon. Then it sulks about the ribbon.
lore.uncommon: Waddles regally through the house as if expecting servants to open every door.
lore.rare: Gave the palace guards such a look that they fetched it a cushion without being asked.
lore.epic: Led a parade of small dogs through the old city, each with a perfectly tied topknot.
lore.legendary: Was given its own wing of the palace, its own garden and its own chef. Still sleeps in the laundry basket.

lore.common: Complains loudly and dramatically when you say "bath". And "walk". And "hello".
lore.uncommon: Can escape from any garden, then sits outside the front door waiting to be let back in.
lore.rare: Its pale blue eyes stare so deep into your soul that you give it half your sandwich.
lore.epic: Led a sled team in the wrong direction because it smelled sausages. The race now has a new finish line.
lore.legendary: Escaped from every kennel, garden and fenced field in the country, then came home to howl about how boring it all was.

lore.common: Its silky coat collects every leaf in the garden like a tiny walking broom.
lore.uncommon: Its blue-and-tan coat shines so smoothly that people think it has been ironed.
lore.rare: Faces down snakes in the outback with a stern little bark. The snakes slither off embarrassed.
lore.epic: Chased a whole flock of cockatoos out of a cricket ground. The match finally started.
lore.legendary: Patrolled a whole sheep station alone for a summer and sent every snake packing with a single bark each.

lore.common: Jumps up to kiss your face every time you come home, even if you only went to the bin.
lore.uncommon: Its coat is so soft that strangers ask to stroke it, and it always says yes.
lore.rare: Its hello dance is so bouncy that the floorboards need replacing every year.
lore.epic: Greeted a whole football crowd one by one at the gate. The match started two hours late.
lore.legendary: Said hello to every single person in the town on one walk and remembered all their names.

lore.common: Wags its whole body so hard that it falls over at the end of every greeting.
lore.uncommon: Watches over the children at the playground and sits beside anyone who looks lonely.
lore.rare: Can pull you down the street on a lead when it smells a sausage, no matter how hard you pull back.
lore.epic: Played so happily on the sofa that the sofa is now in two pieces.
lore.legendary: Pulled a broken-down bus up a hill to the school gates and then asked every child for a pat.

lore.common: Its fancy haircut takes two hours at the groomer and is ruined in one puddle.
lore.uncommon: Retrieves ducks from the lake, then dries its pompoms under the hand dryer at the café.
lore.rare: Can solve any puzzle toy in seconds and then hides the treats for later.
lore.epic: Was so elegant at the city's spring show that the other dogs asked for its autograph.
lore.legendary: Swam across the lake, won the show and was home before tea, without a single curl out of place.

lore.common: Barks at the dishwasher every time it beeps, then waits for it to apologise.
lore.uncommon: Seems to understand every word you say and pretends not to hear the word "bath".
lore.rare: Cleared the farm of rats, foxes and one very surprised badger in a single morning.
lore.epic: Guarded the whole farmyard so carefully that the hens now ask it before laying an egg.
lore.legendary: Took charge of a sleepy village, kept every gate shut and every hen counted, and was made sheriff without a vote.

lore.common: Always looks deeply worried, even while eating its favourite biscuit.
lore.uncommon: Barks quietly to itself while hunting, as if it is narrating a nature programme.
lore.rare: Pushed through a thorn hedge that every other dog refused to touch, then frowned at the thorns.
lore.epic: Barked its way through the whole countryside at a slow walk, and every pheasant knew it was coming.
lore.legendary: Was named the most serious dog in history after attending a hundred birthday parties without once smiling. It enjoyed them all.

names.legendary: Dorje, Lion of the High Monastery

lore.common: Sleeps all day and barks all night, so the house is never sure whose schedule it is on.
lore.uncommon: Has a mane like a lion and a sense of dignity to match. Refuses to wear a raincoat.
lore.rare: Guarded a mountain village so well that the snow leopards sent a letter of complaint.
lore.epic: Barked once in the high valley and the echo knocked the snow off every roof.
lore.legendary: Guarded a monastery on top of the mountains for so long that the monks made it head of the welcoming committee.

lore.common: Its big flat feet act like snowshoes, so it walks on top of the snow and laughs at you sinking.
lore.uncommon: Is considered lucky, so people keep patting it before exams.
lore.rare: Climbed a frozen cliff that the goats wouldn't try, just to look back and wag.
lore.epic: Shook its shaggy coat in the monastery courtyard and caused a small snowstorm.
lore.legendary: Brought so much luck to a mountain village that every lost key in the valley turned up the same afternoon.

lore.common: Rides in a handbag everywhere and complains if the handbag doesn't match.
lore.uncommon: Prances along the pavement on its tiptoes as if the ground is slightly beneath it.
lore.rare: Learned to open the treat cupboard and now runs the kitchen.
lore.epic: Twirled so beautifully at the dog show that the ice dancers asked for lessons.
lore.legendary: Has the largest handbag collection in the city, one for every day of the year, and still rides in yours.

lore.common: Shivers whenever someone opens the fridge, just in case there's something cold in it for it.
lore.uncommon: Hears a mouse in the attic from the garden and runs in to report it.
lore.rare: Caught every mouse in the barn while the cat slept on the hay bales.
lore.epic: Barked so loudly at a burglar that the burglar ran into the police station to ask for protection.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole castle free of mice for its entire life. Was given a tiny castle of its own as thanks.

lore.common: Follows you from room to room, including the bathroom, and looks offended when you close the door.
lore.uncommon: Its golden-rust coat glows in the sunshine, so it is easy to spot sitting on your favourite chair.
lore.rare: Points at a pheasant with such focus that it forgets to blink for five minutes.
lore.epic: Ran through a whole country estate so fast that the gardeners thought a comet had landed.
lore.legendary: Stayed glued to its owner's side for its entire life, including during a hot-air balloon trip. Insisted on piloting.

lore.common: Bays at the moon, the street lamp and the neighbour's porch light. It's not fussy.
lore.uncommon: Runs so fast after a scent that it overtakes the hunters, their horses and their lunch.
lore.rare: Its voice carries so far that people two valleys away come to see who's lost.
lore.epic: Chased a raccoon through the night so loudly that the whole forest gave up on sleep.
lore.legendary: Won the hound race so many times that the trophy is now just its own photo on a stand.

lore.common: Leans against your legs during dinner and stares with its amber eyes until you share.
lore.uncommon: Its silver coat makes it look like a ghost in the early morning mist. The postman runs.
lore.rare: Followed its owner so closely through the woods that the owner kept tripping over it.
lore.epic: Galloped through a misty forest at dawn and everyone in the village swore a ghost had passed.
lore.legendary: Was so devoted to its owner that it learned to open every door in the house, the car and the office building.

lore.common: Springs into every bush on the walk, then comes out looking surprised that it was a bush.
lore.uncommon: Its red-and-white coat makes it look like a little dragon. It plays along.
lore.rare: Flushes every bird out of the hedge, then politely waits for them to settle back in.
lore.epic: Bounced across every valley in Wales in one afternoon and was mistaken for a red dragon.
lore.legendary: Was adopted as the mascot of a whole country's rugby team and bounced so hard after a win that the stadium shook.

names.legendary: Wee Hamish, Digger of the Highlands

lore.common: Digs a hole in the flowerbed, sits in it and waits to be photographed.
lore.uncommon: Its white coat stays white for exactly one minute after a bath.
lore.rare: Squeezed down a rabbit hole and came up in the neighbour's greenhouse holding a tomato.
lore.epic: Dug so many tunnels under a Highland golf course that the balls now roll back to the clubhouse.
lore.legendary: Dug a tunnel straight through a Highland hill to get to the other side faster. The hill is now a short cut.

lore.common: Sprints round the garden at top speed for one minute, then sleeps for six hours.
lore.uncommon: Shivers under two blankets and asks for a third.
lore.rare: Runs so fast that it reaches the ball before it has stopped bouncing.
lore.epic: Raced a train along the coast and beat it to the next station.
lore.legendary: Won every race at the track in one evening, then fell asleep in the winner's enclosure before the trophy arrived.

names.legendary: Aurora, White Queen of the Ice

lore.common: Howls whenever the freezer door is opened because it smells like home.
lore.uncommon: Blends into the snow so perfectly that it sneaks up on its own pack.
lore.rare: Can cross a frozen lake without a single crack, while the polar bears are still testing the ice.
lore.epic: Howled so loudly over the Arctic that the icebergs drifted closer to listen.
lore.legendary: Led its pack across the frozen north for a whole winter and didn't lose a single pup, a single meal or a single argument.

lore.common: Bounces straight up and down like a spring until somebody throws the ball.
lore.uncommon: Its wiry coat holds every twig, leaf and sticky burr from the walk.
lore.rare: Shot down a fox's burrow so fast that the fox came out the back door to see what was going on.
lore.epic: Chased the hunt's horses round the field and won the race without a rider.
lore.legendary: Was declared the bounciest dog in history after bouncing over the garden fence, the shed and the neighbour's caravan.

lore.common: Wears a bow on its head and barks at anyone who doesn't compliment it.
lore.uncommon: Used to chase mice out of the old wool mills and still checks every cupboard for them.
lore.rare: Bosses around dogs ten times its size, and they listen.
lore.epic: Barked at a herd of cows until they walked backwards out of the field.
lore.legendary: Ran a whole house of big dogs, cats and a parrot with one bossy little bark.

lore.common: Sprays water at everyone in the zoo queue, then flaps its ears to pretend it was the wind.
lore.uncommon: Remembers every person who ever gave it a peanut and the ones who didn't.
lore.rare: Can pick up a single peanut or a whole tree with its trunk. Usually picks the peanut.
lore.epic: Took a mud bath so enthusiastically that the whole safari camp now needs a car wash.
lore.legendary: Remembered every birthday of every animal in the jungle for fifty years and threw them all a party on the same day.
